decisions.decision: SHT31-D combined temp+humidity sensor, HMAC-signed device payloads with anti-replay nonce/timestamp, admin-issued device registration (secret shown once)
decisions.rationale: Single sensor simplifies wiring/auth story; anti-replay closes the replay-attack gap PITFALLS.md flagged

decisions.decision: Auth failures (bad signature/replay) are rejected outright (401 + security log, no write) — distinct from authenticated-but-out-of-range readings, which are flagged but retained
decisions.rationale: Conflating auth failure with data-quality flagging would let forged data get 'flagged' instead of rejected, defeating SEC-03

decisions.decision: Configurable N-devices-per-zone data model from day one (not hardcoded single sensor)
decisions.rationale: Phase 3's per-zone humidity target (CTRL-06) already needs a zone concept; avoids schema rework later
